title: Stateful association then Initiate-Request-PDU
purpose: Provide a realistic small stateful sequence with client association setup, server association response, and a final initiate request to seed deeper state-dependent parser behavior.
expected_behavior: A test target should parse the setup AARQ, tolerate the compact AARE response, and then accept the final framed Initiate-Request-PDU for distinct stateful parser coverage.
constraints_preserved: Each message has a complete TPKT header with self-consistent total length.
Message 0 uses ACSE message type 0x60 AARQ and message 1 uses 0x61 AARE.
Message 2 uses documented MMS PDU tag 0xa8 for Initiate-Request-PDU.
COTP data TPDU 02f080 is used on data-bearing messages 1 and 2.
BER definite lengths are consistent in all three messages.
No negative lengths, truncation, or raw crash fragments are used.
issue_safety_notes: The sequence is issue-informed only in preferring valid state transitions over malformed setup. It is not an exact replay of any historical input.
